baseline_comparison: existing accepted-output comparison only; no new baseline pilot lane

cases.process: u u~ > z z g g [virt=QCD]

sampling.source: new separate deterministic cut-qualified physical RAMBO streams; generated and frozen only in the admitted prepare stage; never subset registered fixtures
sampling.boundary_rule: strictly greater than both declared cuts

policy.precision: forced DP primary diagnostics; actual backend and precision checked per result
policy.numerator_and_model: unchanged canonical generated Fortran; no private adaptive or mass/geometry patch
policy.warnings: ##W03 invalidates the affected raw diagnostic and is explicitly retained
policy.positive_120: unchecked forced-QP output; excluded from the raw-DP curve because it indicates QP execution
policy.positive_110: unchecked forced-DP diagnostic output; never host-qualified or used as independent true error
policy.active_loop_group_coverage: after each call, retain stability flags and finite outputs for active nonzero numerator loop groups; failed or unknown coverage invalidates that diagnostic even if unchecked return code is 110 and the amplitude is finite
policy.backend_observation: effective singleton card selection; unchecked U=0 is not an actual backend observation; any later ABI observer requires its own reviewed binding

statistics.raw_DP_observable: finite coefficient divided by Born; the common alpha_s/(2*pi) factor used by the legacy Born-process display cancels from the relative spread in exact arithmetic; raw coefficients also retained
statistics.zero_mean: all identical zero values yield metric zero; nonzero spread with zero mean yields positive infinity
statistics.ratio: tail_backend/tail_Ninja only where both complete and Ninja numerator count > 0; otherwise mask
statistics.zero_metrics: reported separately; never replaced by a fabricated numerical floor in raw data
statistics.confidence: no population confidence claim for deterministic fixtures; full random-sample campaign may add explicitly pointwise binomial intervals

delivery.plots: vector PDF plus PNG previews, raw point metrics and JSON summaries
delivery.labels: 100-point pilot; raw forced-DP internal consistency diagnostic; not an independent true-error bound
delivery.local_TODO: larger frozen random samples: 100000 points for 2-to-2, 10000 for 2-to-3, 1000 for 2-to-4; separate genuine-QP and post-rescue profiles
delivery.ordinary_and_stress_populations: separate panels; no pooled failure fractions

preparation.outer_environment: clean compiler/helper environment; native LD_LIBRARY_PATH applied only at target execve
preparation.native_closure: fresh private executable PT_INTERP and actual loader closure; historical host ldd interpreter retained separately, not required in target maps
